Ui.Script:
local PREFIX = "RWBOTTLE" local A_REROLL, A_GAMBLE, A_EMPOWER, A_AWAKEN, A_POUR, A_ABSORB = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 local TIER_COLOR = { "ffffffff", "ff1eff00", "ff0070dd", "ffa335ee", "ffff8000" } local SLOT_NAMES = { "Primary", "Secondary", "Bonus" } local COLS, SHOWN_ROWS, CELL = 8, 10, 31 local ROW_HEIGHT = 54
-- The options, in the order the left column shows them. `needs`: what the item must have -- for the option ("enchant": a random enchant, "empty": an empty enchant slot, "bag": to -- lie in the bags). local OPTIONS = { { action = A_REROLL, name = "Reroll", needs = "enchant", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Dice_01", general = "Costs the tier's value", about = "Turns one random enchant into another random enchant of the same tier." }, { action = A_GAMBLE, name = "Gamble", needs = "enchant", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Coin_02", general = "Costs the tier's value", about = "Rerolls one random enchant: 25% one tier down, 50% the same tier, 25% one tier up." }, { action = A_EMPOWER, name = "Empower", needs = "enchant", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Enchant_EssenceMagicLarge", general = "Costs 2x the next tier's value", about = "Raises one random enchant a tier, keeping its stat." }, { action = A_AWAKEN, name = "Awaken", needs = "empty", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Enchant_ShardBrilliantSmall", general = "Costs 1.5x the tier's value", about = "Fills an empty enchant slot with a random enchant rolled from the item's quality, " .. "as high a tier as your charges pay for." }, { action = A_POUR, name = "Pour stored enchant", needs = "empty", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Potion_51", general = "Costs 2x the stored tier's value", about = "Pours the bottle's stored enchant into an empty enchant slot." }, { action = A_ABSORB, name = "Absorb", needs = "bag", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Enchant_Disenchant", general = "Gives charges, destroys the item", about = "Destroys a weapon or armor piece from your bags for charges (its tiers' values) " .. "and stores its best enchant in the bottle." }, }
-- The server's last state, and the window's selection: `pos` is where the item lies -- ({ kind = "bag", bag, slot } or { kind = "worn", id }, the client's numbering) and -- `item` what the server said of it (ITEM). local B = { charges = 0, stored = 0, storedTier = 0, storedName = "", pour = 0, awaken = 0 } local sel = { option = 1, pos = nil, item = nil, eslot = nil } local pending, waited = false, 0 local picked = nil local tab, scroll = "bags", 0 local frame
local function split(text) local fields = {} for field in (text .. "\t"):gmatch("([^\t]*)\t") do table.insert(fields, field) end return fields end
local function send(text) SendAddonMessage(PREFIX, text, "WHISPER", UnitName("player")) end
local function charges_text(n) if n == 1 then return "1 charge" end return n .. " charges" end
-- The core numbers the backpack as bag 255, slots 23-38, the equipped bags 19-22 with -- slots from 0, and the worn gear as bag 255, slots 0-18. local function server_pos(pos) if pos.kind == "worn" then return 255, pos.id - 1 end if pos.bag == 0 then return 255, pos.slot + 22 end return pos.bag + 18, pos.slot - 1 end
local function same_pos(a, b) return a and b and a.kind == b.kind and a.bag == b.bag and a.slot == b.slot and a.id == b.id end
local function link_at(pos) if pos.kind == "worn" then return GetInventoryItemLink("player", pos.id) end return GetContainerItemLink(pos.bag, pos.slot) end
local function texture_at(pos) if pos.kind == "worn" then return GetInventoryItemTexture("player", pos.id), 1 end local texture, count = GetContainerItemInfo(pos.bag, pos.slot) return texture, count end
local function entry_at(pos) local link = link_at(pos) return link and tonumber(link:match("item:(%d+)")) end
-- Weapons and armor are what the bottle works on; everything else is dimmed in the grid. local function equippable(link) if not link then return false end local _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, equipLoc = GetItemInfo(link) return equipLoc ~= nil and equipLoc ~= "" and equipLoc ~= "INVTYPE_BAG" and equipLoc ~= "INVTYPE_AMMO" and equipLoc ~= "INVTYPE_QUIVER" end
local function set_tooltip(owner, pos) GameTooltip:SetOwner(owner, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") if pos.kind == "worn" then GameTooltip:SetInventoryItem("player", pos.id) else GameTooltip:SetBagItem(pos.bag, pos.slot) end GameTooltip:Show() end
-- The rules -------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function slot_ok(option, s) if not s then return false end if option.needs == "enchant" then if s.tier == 0 then return false end return option.action ~= A_EMPOWER or s.empower > 0 end if option.needs == "empty" then return s.id == 0 and (option.action ~= A_POUR or B.stored ~= 0) end return false end
-- The enchant slot an option works on: the chosen one if it fits, else the first that does. local function slot_for(option) local item = sel.item if not item or option.needs == "bag" then return nil end if sel.eslot and slot_ok(option, item.slots[sel.eslot]) then return sel.eslot end for si = 1, 3 do if slot_ok(option, item.slots[si]) then return si end end return nil end
local function cost_of(option, si) if option.action == A_ABSORB then return sel.item and sel.item.absorb or 0 elseif option.action == A_AWAKEN then return B.awaken elseif option.action == A_POUR then return B.pour end local s = sel.item and si and sel.item.slots[si] if not s then return 0 elseif option.action == A_EMPOWER then return s.empower end return s.reroll end
-- Whether `option` can be applied to the item in the slot, and if not, why. local function refusal(option) local item = sel.item if not item then return "Put an item in the slot first." end if option.action == A_ABSORB then if sel.pos.kind == "worn" then return "Only items in your bags can be absorbed. Take it off first." elseif item.absorb == 0 then return "It has no random enchants to absorb." end return nil end if option.action == A_POUR and B.stored == 0 then return "The bottle stores no enchant. Absorbing or disenchanting an item stores its best one." end if slot_for(option) then return nil end if option.needs == "empty" then return "Every enchant slot of this item is taken." end for si = 1, 3 do if item.slots[si].tier > 0 then return "Its random enchants are already at the highest tier." end end return "It has no random enchant." end
local function enchant_text(s) return string.format("|c%s%s|r (T%d)", TIER_COLOR[s.tier] or "ffffffff", s.name, s.tier) end
local function effect_text(option, si) if not sel.item then return option.about .. "\n\n|cff9d9d9dPut a weapon or armor piece in the slot: drag it here " .. "from your bags or your character, or click it on the right.|r" end local why = refusal(option) if why then return option.about .. "\n\n|cffff6060" .. why .. "|r" end local s = si and sel.item.slots[si] local cost = cost_of(option, si) local text if option.action == A_REROLL then text = string.format("Rerolls %s into another random T%d enchant.", enchant_text(s), s.tier) elseif option.action == A_GAMBLE then text = string.format("Rerolls %s: 25%% T%d, 50%% T%d, 25%% T%d.", enchant_text(s), math.max(s.tier - 1, 1), s.tier, math.min(s.tier + 1, 5)) elseif option.action == A_EMPOWER then text = string.format("Raises %s to its T%d version, same stat.", enchant_text(s), s.tier + 1) elseif option.action == A_AWAKEN then text = string.format("Fills the empty %s slot with a random enchant rolled from the " .. "item's quality, as high a tier as your charges pay for (1.5x its value).", SLOT_NAMES[si]:lower()) elseif option.action == A_POUR then text = string.format("Pours %s into the empty %s slot. The bottle's store empties.", enchant_text({ name = B.storedName, tier = B.storedTier }), SLOT_NAMES[si]:lower()) else text = "Destroys the item and stores its best enchant in the bottle" if B.stored ~= 0 then text = text .. ", replacing " .. B.storedName end return text .. string.format(".\n\n|cff66ff66Gives %s.|r", charges_text(cost)) end local price = (option.action == A_AWAKEN) and "Costs at least %s." or "Costs %s." text = text .. "\n\n" .. string.format(price, charges_text(cost)) if cost > B.charges then text = text .. string.format(" |cffff6060The bottle holds %d.|r", B.charges) end return text end
-- The frame -------------------------------------------------------------------------
frame = CreateFrame("Frame", "RustWrathBottleFrame", UIParent) frame:Hide() frame:SetWidth(786) frame:SetHeight(456) frame:SetPoint("CENTER", UIParent, "CENTER", 0, 40) frame:SetFrameStrata("DIALOG") frame:SetToplevel(true) frame:EnableMouse(true) frame:SetMovable(true) frame:SetClampedToScreen(true) frame:RegisterForDrag("LeftButton") frame:SetScript("OnDragStart", function() frame:StartMoving() end) frame:SetScript("OnDragStop", function() frame:StopMovingOrSizing() end) frame:SetBackdrop({ bgFile = "Interface\\DialogFrame\\UI-DialogBox-Background", edgeFile = "Interface\\DialogFrame\\UI-DialogBox-Border", tile = true, tileSize = 32, edgeSize = 32, insets = { left = 11, right = 12, top = 12, bottom = 11 }, }) if UISpecialFrames then table.insert(UISpecialFrames, "RustWrathBottleFrame") end
local header = frame:CreateTexture(nil, "ARTWORK") header:SetTexture("Interface\\DialogFrame\\UI-DialogBox-Header") header:SetWidth(300) header:SetHeight(64) header:SetPoint("TOP", frame, "TOP", 0, 12) local title = frame:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormal") title:SetPoint("TOP", header, "TOP", 0, -14) title:SetText("Enchant Bottle")
local close = CreateFrame("Button", "RustWrathBottleFrameClose", frame, "UIPanelCloseButton") close:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", frame, "TOPRIGHT", -6, -6) close:SetScript("OnClick", function() frame:Hide() end)
-- The bottle's contents, under the title. local chargesText = frame:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormal") chargesText:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", frame, "TOPLEFT", 26, -34) chargesText:SetJustifyH("LEFT") local storedText = frame:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormalSmall") storedText:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", frame, "TOPRIGHT", -40, -36) storedText:SetWidth(420) storedText:SetJustifyH("RIGHT")
local function inset(x, y, width, height) local box = CreateFrame("Frame", nil, frame) box:SetWidth(width) box:SetHeight(height) box:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", frame, "TOPLEFT", x, y) box:SetBackdrop({ bgFile = "Interface\\Tooltips\\UI-Tooltip-Background", edgeFile = "Interface\\Tooltips\\UI-Tooltip-Border", tile = true, tileSize = 16, edgeSize = 16, insets = { left = 4, right = 4, top = 4, bottom = 4 }, }) box:SetBackdropColor(0.04, 0.03, 0.08, 0.85) box:SetBackdropBorderColor(0.6, 0.6, 0.6, 1) return box end
local function label(text, x, y) local fs = frame:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontHighlight") fs:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", frame, "TOPLEFT", x, y) fs:SetText(text) return fs end
-- Left: the options --------------------------------------------------------------------
label("Options", 26, -58) local optionBox = inset(20, -74, 240, 6 * ROW_HEIGHT + 14) local rows = {} for i = 1, table.getn(OPTIONS) do local option = OPTIONS[i] local row = CreateFrame("Button", nil, optionBox) row:SetWidth(228) row:SetHeight(ROW_HEIGHT - 2) row:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", optionBox, "TOPLEFT", 6, -7 - (i - 1) * ROW_HEIGHT) row.icon = row:CreateTexture(nil, "ARTWORK") row.icon:SetWidth(36) row.icon:SetHeight(36) row.icon:SetPoint("LEFT", row, "LEFT", 6, 0) row.icon:SetTexture(option.icon) row.name = row:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormal") row.name:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", row.icon, "TOPRIGHT", 8, -2) row.name:SetWidth(172) row.name:SetJustifyH("LEFT") row.name:SetText(option.name) row.sub = row:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontHighlightSmall") row.sub:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", row.name, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -4) row.sub:SetWidth(172) row.sub:SetJustifyH("LEFT") row.mark = row:CreateTexture(nil, "BACKGROUND") row.mark:SetAllPoints(row) row.mark:SetTexture("Interface\\QuestFrame\\UI-QuestLogTitleHighlight") row.mark:SetBlendMode("ADD") row.mark:SetVertexColor(1, 0.82, 0, 0.7) row.mark:Hide() row:SetHighlightTexture("Interface\\QuestFrame\\UI-QuestTitleHighlight", "ADD") row:SetScript("OnClick", function() sel.option = i RustWrathBottle_Render() end) rows[i] = row end
-- Centre: the item slot, its enchants, the effect and the buttons -----------------------
local CX, CW = 272, 220 local dropLabel = frame:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormal") dropLabel:SetPoint("TOP", frame, "TOPLEFT", CX + CW / 2, -66) dropLabel:SetText("Drop item here")
local drop = CreateFrame("Button", "RustWrathBottleDropSlot", frame) drop:SetWidth(52) drop:SetHeight(52) drop:SetPoint("TOP", frame, "TOPLEFT", CX + CW / 2, -88) drop:RegisterForClicks("LeftButtonUp", "RightButtonUp") local dropBack = drop:CreateTexture(nil, "BACKGROUND") dropBack:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-EmptySlot") dropBack:SetWidth(90) dropBack:SetHeight(90) dropBack:SetPoint("CENTER", drop, "CENTER", 0, 0) drop.icon = drop:CreateTexture(nil, "ARTWORK") drop.icon:SetAllPoints(drop) drop:SetHighlightTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\ButtonHilight-Square", "ADD")
local itemName = frame:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontHighlight") itemName:SetPoint("TOP", drop, "BOTTOM", 0, -8) itemName:SetWidth(CW)
-- The item's three enchant slots; the selected option picks among the ones it can use. local eslots = {} for si = 1, 3 do local line = CreateFrame("Button", nil, frame) line:SetWidth(CW) line:SetHeight(18) line:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", frame, "TOPLEFT", CX, -170 - (si - 1) * 19) line.text = line:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontHighlightSmall") line.text:SetPoint("LEFT", line, "LEFT", 6, 0) line.text:SetWidth(CW - 12) line.text:SetJustifyH("LEFT") line.mark = line:CreateTexture(nil, "BACKGROUND") line.mark:SetAllPoints(line) line.mark:SetTexture("Interface\\QuestFrame\\UI-QuestLogTitleHighlight") line.mark:SetBlendMode("ADD") line.mark:SetVertexColor(1, 0.82, 0, 0.6) line.mark:Hide() line:SetHighlightTexture("Interface\\QuestFrame\\UI-QuestTitleHighlight", "ADD") line:SetScript("OnClick", function() if line.usable then sel.eslot = si RustWrathBottle_Render() end end) line:Hide() eslots[si] = line end
local effect = frame:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontHighlightSmall") effect:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", frame, "TOPLEFT", CX, -232) effect:SetWidth(CW) effect:SetHeight(110) effect:SetJustifyH("LEFT") effect:SetJustifyV("TOP")
local cancel = CreateFrame("Button", "RustWrathBottleCancel", frame, "UIPanelButtonTemplate") cancel:SetWidth(100) cancel:SetHeight(22) cancel:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", frame, "TOPLEFT", CX + 4, -352) cancel:SetText(CANCEL or "Cancel")
local apply = CreateFrame("Button", "RustWrathBottleApply", frame, "UIPanelButtonTemplate") apply:SetWidth(100) apply:SetHeight(22) apply:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", frame, "TOPLEFT", CX + CW - 4, -352) apply:SetText("Apply")
local result = frame:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontHighlightSmall") result:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", frame, "TOPLEFT", CX, -382) result:SetWidth(CW) result:SetHeight(56) result:SetJustifyH("CENTER") result:SetJustifyV("TOP")
-- Right: the bags, or the worn gear --------------------------------------------------
local GX = 506 label("Bags", GX + 6, -58) local gridBox = inset(GX, -74, COLS * CELL + 14, SHOWN_ROWS * CELL + 14) local tabs = {} local function make_tab(name, text, x) local b = CreateFrame("Button", "RustWrathBottleTab" .. name, frame, "UIPanelButtonTemplate") b:SetWidth(64) b:SetHeight(20) b:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", gridBox, "TOPRIGHT", x, 1) b:SetText(text) b:SetScript("OnClick", function() tab, scroll = name, 0 RustWrathBottle_Render() end) tabs[name] = b end make_tab("worn", "Worn", 0) make_tab("bags", "Bags", -66)
local cells = {} for i = 1, COLS * SHOWN_ROWS do local cell = CreateFrame("Button", nil, gridBox) cell:SetWidth(CELL - 2) cell:SetHeight(CELL - 2) cell:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", gridBox, "TOPLEFT", 8 + ((i - 1) - math.floor((i - 1) / COLS) * COLS) * CELL, -8 - math.floor((i - 1) / COLS) * CELL) cell:RegisterForClicks("LeftButtonUp", "RightButtonUp") cell:RegisterForDrag("LeftButton") local back = cell:CreateTexture(nil, "BACKGROUND") back:SetTexture("Interface\\Paperdoll\\UI-Backpack-EmptySlot") back:SetAllPoints(cell) cell.icon = cell:CreateTexture(nil, "ARTWORK") cell.icon:SetAllPoints(cell) cell.count = cell:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "NumberFontNormalSmall") cell.count:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", cell, "BOTTOMRIGHT", -2, 2) cell.mark = cell:CreateTexture(nil, "OVERLAY") cell.mark:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\CheckButtonHilight") cell.mark:SetBlendMode("ADD") cell.mark:SetAllPoints(cell) cell.mark:Hide() cell:SetHighlightTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\ButtonHilight-Square", "ADD") cell:SetScript("OnClick", function() if cell.pos and cell.filled then RustWrathBottle_Pick(cell.pos) end end) cell:SetScript("OnDragStart", function() local pos = cell.pos if pos and cell.filled then if pos.kind == "worn" then PickupInventoryItem(pos.id) else PickupContainerItem(pos.bag, pos.slot) end end end) cell:SetScript("OnEnter", function() if cell.pos and cell.filled then set_tooltip(cell, cell.pos) end end) cell:SetScript("OnLeave", function() GameTooltip:Hide() end) cells[i] = cell end local more = frame:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontDisableSmall") more:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", gridBox, "BOTTOMRIGHT", -4, -4)
local function grid_positions() local list = {} if tab == "worn" then for id = 1, 19 do table.insert(list, { kind = "worn", id = id }) end else for bag = 0, 4 do for slot = 1, (GetContainerNumSlots(bag) or 0) do table.insert(list, { kind = "bag", bag = bag, slot = slot }) end end end return list end
local function max_scroll(n) return math.max(0, math.ceil(n / COLS) - SHOWN_ROWS) end
gridBox:EnableMouseWheel(true) gridBox:SetScript("OnMouseWheel", function(_, delta) delta = delta or arg1 local n = table.getn(grid_positions()) scroll = math.min(math.max(scroll - delta, 0), max_scroll(n)) RustWrathBottle_Render() end)
-- Rendering ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function RustWrathBottle_Render() chargesText:SetText(string.format("Charges: |cffffffff%d|r", B.charges)) if B.stored ~= 0 then storedText:SetText(string.format("Stored enchant: |c%s%s|r (T%d)", TIER_COLOR[B.storedTier] or "ffffffff", B.storedName, B.storedTier)) else storedText:SetText("Stored enchant: |cff9d9d9dnone|r") end
local option = OPTIONS[sel.option] sel.eslot = slot_for(option)
for i = 1, table.getn(OPTIONS) do local row, o = rows[i], OPTIONS[i] local why = sel.item and refusal(o) if not sel.item then row.sub:SetText(o.general) row.sub:SetTextColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.8) elseif why then row.sub:SetText("Not for this item") row.sub:SetTextColor(0.6, 0.6, 0.6) else local cost = cost_of(o, slot_for(o)) if o.action == A_ABSORB then row.sub:SetText("Gives " .. charges_text(cost)) row.sub:SetTextColor(0.4, 1, 0.4) else row.sub:SetText((o.action == A_AWAKEN and "From " or "") .. charges_text(cost)) if cost > B.charges then row.sub:SetTextColor(1, 0.38, 0.38) else row.sub:SetTextColor(1, 1, 1) end end end row.icon:SetDesaturated(why and true or false) if why then row.name:SetTextColor(0.55, 0.55, 0.55) else row.name:SetTextColor(1, 0.82, 0) end if i == sel.option then row.mark:Show() else row.mark:Hide() end end
-- The item slot. if sel.pos and sel.item then drop.icon:SetTexture((texture_at(sel.pos))) local link = link_at(sel.pos) itemName:SetText(link and link:gsub("|H.-|h(.-)|h", "%1") or "") for si = 1, 3 do local line, s = eslots[si], sel.item.slots[si] local text if s.id == 0 then text = "|cff9d9d9dempty|r" elseif s.tier == 0 then text = s.name .. " |cff9d9d9d(not random)|r" else text = enchant_text(s) end line.text:SetText("|cffffd100" .. SLOT_NAMES[si] .. ":|r " .. text) line.usable = slot_ok(option, s) line.text:SetAlpha((line.usable or option.needs == "bag") and 1 or 0.55) if si == sel.eslot then line.mark:Show() else line.mark:Hide() end line:Show() end else drop.icon:SetTexture(nil) itemName:SetText(pending and "" or "|cff9d9d9dEmpty|r") for si = 1, 3 do eslots[si]:Hide() end end
effect:SetText(effect_text(option, sel.eslot)) local can = sel.item and not refusal(option) and not pending if can and option.action ~= A_ABSORB then local need = option.action == A_AWAKEN and B.awaken or cost_of(option, sel.eslot) can = need <= B.charges end if can then apply:Enable() else apply:Disable() end
-- The grid. local list = grid_positions() scroll = math.min(scroll, max_scroll(table.getn(list))) for i = 1, COLS * SHOWN_ROWS do local cell, pos = cells[i], list[scroll * COLS + i] cell.pos = pos if pos then local texture, count = texture_at(pos) cell.filled = texture ~= nil cell.icon:SetTexture(texture) local usable = texture and equippable(link_at(pos)) cell.icon:SetDesaturated(texture and not usable or false) cell.icon:SetAlpha(usable and 1 or 0.45) cell.count:SetText((count and count > 1) and count or "") if same_pos(pos, sel.pos) then cell.mark:Show() else cell.mark:Hide() end cell:Show() else cell.filled = false cell:Hide() end end if max_scroll(table.getn(list)) > 0 then more:SetText("Scroll for more") else more:SetText("") end if tab == "bags" then tabs.bags:LockHighlight() tabs.worn:UnlockHighlight() else tabs.worn:LockHighlight() tabs.bags:UnlockHighlight() end end
-- Choosing and applying ----------------------------------------------------------------
local function wait() pending, waited = true, 0 end
local function clear_item() sel.pos, sel.item, sel.eslot = nil, nil, nil end
function RustWrathBottle_Pick(pos) if pending then return end sel.pos, sel.item = pos, nil result:SetText("") local bag, slot = server_pos(pos) wait() RustWrathBottle_Render() send("PICK\t" .. bag .. "\t" .. slot) end
-- An item dropped on the slot: the position the last pickup took it from, if the cursor -- still holds that item. The pickup goes back where it was. local function take_cursor() if not CursorHasItem() then return false end local kind, id = GetCursorInfo() local pos = picked if kind ~= "item" or not pos or entry_at(pos) ~= id then ClearCursor() result:SetText("|cffff6060Drag an item from your bags or your character.|r") return true end ClearCursor() RustWrathBottle_Pick(pos) return true end
if hooksecurefunc then hooksecurefunc("PickupContainerItem", function(bag, slot) picked = { kind = "bag", bag = bag, slot = slot } end) hooksecurefunc("PickupInventoryItem", function(id) picked = { kind = "worn", id = id } end) end
drop:SetScript("OnReceiveDrag", function() take_cursor() end) drop:SetScript("OnClick", function(_, button) button = button or arg1 if take_cursor() then return end if button == "RightButton" and not pending then clear_item() result:SetText("") RustWrathBottle_Render() end end) drop:SetScript("OnEnter", function() if sel.pos and sel.item then set_tooltip(drop, sel.pos) GameTooltip:AddLine("Right-click to take it out.", 0.6, 0.6, 0.6) GameTooltip:Show() end end) drop:SetScript("OnLeave", function() GameTooltip:Hide() end)
local function send_apply(action, eslot) local bag, slot = server_pos(sel.pos) wait() result:SetText("|cff9d9d9dWorking...|r") RustWrathBottle_Render() send("APPLY\t" .. action .. "\t" .. bag .. "\t" .. slot .. "\t" .. (eslot or 0)) end
StaticPopupDialogs = StaticPopupDialogs or {} StaticPopupDialogs["RUSTWRATH_BOTTLE_ABSORB"] = { text = "Destroy %s for %s?", button1 = YES, button2 = NO, OnAccept = function() if sel.item and not pending then send_apply(A_ABSORB, 0) end end, timeout = 0, whileDead = 1, hideOnEscape = 1, showAlert = 1, }
apply:SetScript("OnClick", function() local option = OPTIONS[sel.option] if not sel.item or pending or refusal(option) then return end if option.action == A_ABSORB then local link = link_at(sel.pos) or "this item" StaticPopup_Show("RUSTWRATH_BOTTLE_ABSORB", link, charges_text(sel.item.absorb)) return end send_apply(option.action, sel.eslot) end)
cancel:SetScript("OnClick", function() frame:Hide() end)
-- The server link ---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function on_item(f) local pos = sel.pos if not pos then return end local bag, slot = server_pos(pos) if tonumber(f[2]) ~= bag or tonumber(f[3]) ~= slot then return end if f[5] ~= "1" then -- Gone (absorbed) or never a weapon or armor piece of the player's. if sel.item == nil and (result:GetText() or "") == "" then result:SetText("|cffff6060The bottle works on weapons and armor only.|r") end clear_item() return end local item = { entry = tonumber(f[4]) or 0, absorb = tonumber(f[6]) or 0, slots = {} } for si = 1, 3 do local at = 6 + (si - 1) * 5 item.slots[si] = { id = tonumber(f[at + 1]) or 0, tier = tonumber(f[at + 2]) or 0, reroll = tonumber(f[at + 3]) or 0, empower = tonumber(f[at + 4]) or 0, name = f[at + 5] or "" } end sel.item = item end
